title: "Worked_example"
author: "Aryan Jaiswal"
---

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

site_locations <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(head(site_locations))
migration_sites <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migration_sites))

selected_sites <- site_locations |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)
gt(selected_sites)
```


```{r}
selected_migration_sites <- migration_sites |> select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, 
         Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
         Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)
gt(selected_migration_sites)
```



```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- selected_sites |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

bird_migration_exc <- selected_migration_sites |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```


```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse (bird_migration_grouped)

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
                      summarise( median_stopover_lat = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                      median_stopover_long = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                      median_iberian_lat = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                      median_iberian_long = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                      median_westmost_lat = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                      median_westmost_long = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                      median_winter_lat = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                      median_winter_long = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  rename(Stopover_Latitude= median_stopover_lat,
         Stopover_Longitude=median_stopover_long,Iberian_Latitude=median_iberian_lat,
         Iberian_Longitude=median_iberian_long, Westmost_Latitude=median_westmost_lat,
         Westmost_Longitude=median_westmost_long,Winter_Latitude=median_winter_lat,
         Winter_Longitude=median_winter_long)

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc,bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```


```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```


```{r}
spring <- c("Breeding","Stopover","Winter")
autumn <- c("Iberian","Westmost","Breeding","Winter")
spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% spring)
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% autumn)
gt(spring_data)
gt(autumn_data)
```



```{r}
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(spring_data, aes(
  x = "Longitude",
  y = "Latitude"
)) +
  geom_point()
```
